fichas.title: Ramps in Multi-Storey Car Parks
fichas.summary: Overview of ramp systems for overcoming level differences in multi-storey car parks: straight continuous ramps, sloping parking floors, half-storey offset ramps (D’Humy), and spiral ramps. The text gives guidance on gradients, transitions from public roads, spiral-ramp geometry, and pedestrian provision. Figures illustrate ramp arrangements, widths, access control, and half-storey layouts.
